text:
jamie: Heads-up — runtime 3.2 affinity change landed in canary this morning. Observed sticky allocation to a small subset of hosts. Thoughts on pin vs temporary unpin? :thinking:
rachel: Saw a small bump in p95 on longseq tests, about +12ms. Not dramatic but consistent across a few models. :eyes:
sasha: SDK teams reported one client lib that still requests runtime v3.1 explicitly. If we unpin we might break them. Need a compatibility list.
ed: Can we scope the unpin only for quantized variants? The issue seems amplified for long-sequence quant runs.
jamie: Good point. Proposal: soft-unpin for non-quant models, keep quant pinned for 2h while we roll a hotfix. Rollforward plan if telemetry stable.
priya: Also check KV cache warm-up — the hosts that got tasks had higher cold miss rate. That could explain the latency blip.
deploybot: Automated canary health check finished:
```
canary-check --runtime=3.2 --window=30m
results: p50: OK, p95: +12ms, error-rate: 0.03% (baseline 0.02%)
sticky-hosts: 4 of 120 active
sdk-mismatch: 1 client pinned to 3.1
```
rachel: That sdk mismatch client is an internal test harness, not production, so low risk. But we should still notify SDK owners.
sasha: I'll post in #eng-platform to coordinate a quick SDK patch. Can someone prepare the rollback steps if we hit >20ms p95?
ed: Rollback plan: 1) lift soft-unpin, 2) revert runtime affinity config via configmap, 3) kick rolling restart of serving pods in impacted zones, 4) route traffic to fallback model variant for critical routes. I have commands ready.
priya: For observability, add a short-term trace sampling increase for the affected model groups. I can enable for 2 hours.
jamie: OK decision: perform a scoped soft-unpin for non-quant models at +10m, monitor for 30m. Keep quant pinned until we push a micro-fix (ETA 90m). Sasha/Ed own rollback if p95 > 20ms or error-rate > 0.1%. Priya ramp traces. Rachel send SDK-alert. :thumbsup:
sasha: ack, I'll send the SDK heads a tiny PR and ping in #eng-platform.
ed: prepping rollback commands now, will paste in thread when ready.
ci-bot: Preflight checks run: all CI green except one flaky longseq test (already annotated).
jamie: Thanks — let's reconvene in 45m. If anyone sees anything odd ping me directly.
priya: enabling traces now.
sasha: PR posted, tagging @sdk-team.
ed: Rollback snippet (saving here):
```
kubectl apply -f runtime-affinity-revert.yaml --context=prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-serving --namespace=redwood
# route control plane: /v1/route/fallback?group=high-priority
```
jamie: Logging the decision and action items in the release notes draft. Will update post-check. :memo:
priya: still seeing higher cold miss rate at one host — isolating it to an HW flake. Opening infra ticket.
rachel: updating canary dashboard with the decision and thresholds.
jamie: closing loop — scoped unpin starts in 8m. Thanks team.
